description:
The 'TailwindTraders' project has a development build pipeline ('TailwindTraders-Dev-CI') that builds the application in debug mode on every commit. You need to establish a parallel production pipeline.

Your task:
1. Create a new build pipeline named 'TailwindTraders-Prod' by cloning the existing 'TailwindTraders-Dev-CI' pipeline.
2. Configure the new pipeline to build in 'release' mode by setting the 'buildConfiguration' variable to 'release'.
3. Disable the Continuous Integration (CI) trigger for this new pipeline so it only runs manually.
4. Save the pipeline.
